name: Orbit
author: Steven Meyers (2000) — implementation: Abstract Games factory

labels.pie: Pie rule — White may swap after Black's first move
labels.refined: Refined pie rule — Player 1 plays B/W/B, then Player 2 picks a colour

description: Steven Meyers' Go variant without liberties or ko. Stones connect orthogonally AND diagonally; a group that seals off points together with one side of the board forms a half-orbit (the opponent may never play inside), and a group that seals points off entirely forms an orbit (captures the enemy stones inside as well). Two passes end the game; you score the vacant points inside your own formations, and points inside both players' formations count for nobody.
